title: contract & grant opportunities - u.s. embassy in nepal
paragraphs: the u.s. embassy in kathmandu seeks to enter into contracts with qualified, reliable firms with sufficient facilities, financing, and work experience for the services listed below.
the u.s. embassy in kathmandu seeks to enter into contracts with qualified, reliable firms with sufficient facilities, financing, and work experience for the services listed below.

the u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition for a  american ai for business reporting and investment confidence initiative to submit proposals. this program advances u.s. policy priorities by promoting adoption of american ai technologies, strengthening nepal’s digital economy, and improving the information environment that entrepreneurs, investors, and companies, including american companies, rely on when assessing opportunities in nepal. notice-of-funding-opportunity nofo: american ai for business reporting and investment confidence initiative the u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition for a communications campaign on illegal migration risks and economic stability to submit proposals. this initiative seeks high-impact projects that address priority challenges while delivering measurable impact at the local and national levels. nofo: strategic communications campaign on illegal migration risks and economic stability the u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition to implement a program to strengthen nepal’s investment climate by enhancing policy communication, regulatory transparency, and analysis, and private sector engagement through training in strategic communications and ai-driven insights.  this program will support entrepreneurs, business leaders, and government officials in articulating clear, evidence-based policy recommendations and engaging constructively with key stakeholders to advance reforms that improve the ease of doing business in nepal. nofo: government and private sector strategic communications and policy advocacy for investment climate u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition to implement the united states embassy youth council (usyc) program, a flagship initiative that strengthens youth leadership, practical skills, and community service across nepal. established in 2011, the program brings together 55 young professionals each year for workshops, mentorship, and project-based learning. usyc members design and implement initiatives that respond to local needs while building professional capabilities that support nepal’s economic and social development. nofo – nepal – u.s. embassy youth council nepal (pdf 517kb) the u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition to implement a program to foster greater commercial ties between the united states and nepal. this program aims to support economic growth in nepal by creating market opportunities for u.s. businesses and investors, strengthening connections between u.s. and nepali businesses, encouraging a more informed nepali consumer base for u.s. products and business opportunities, building on existing networks, including alumni of commercial diplomacy programs. nofo for the nepal-u.s. linked entrepreneurship accelerator program funding opportunity announcement (pdf 501kb) the u.s. embassy nepal announces an open competition for alumni of u.s. government-funded and u.s. government-sponsored exchange programs to apply for the 2026 alumni engagement innovation fund (aeif 2026).  this flagship initiative supports alumni-led projects that advance u.s. foreign policy priorities and deliver measurable impact at the local, national, and regional levels. more details and forms: nofo for alumni engagement innovation fund nepal 2026 (.docx 2mb) aeif 2026 proposal form (.docx 71kb) aeif 2026 monitoring and evaluation resource guide (.docx 38kb) aeif 2026 budget form (.xlsx 34kb)
